note: The AI uses this card only when you include it in a request.

fields.name: Use the name you want the AI to use for this character.
fields.aliases: List nicknames or other names, separated by commas, so the AI can recognise the same character.
fields.tags: Add comma-separated labels to organise and find this card.
fields.description: Give a short introduction: who they are, their role and what makes them distinctive.
fields.personality: Describe traits, habits and reactions. Concrete examples help the AI keep behaviour consistent.
fields.motivations: Write what they want and why it matters. This helps the AI give their choices a clear reason.
fields.appearance: Describe visible features and clothing the AI should mention consistently.
fields.background: Summarise past events that shape how they act now.
fields.speakingStyle: Describe vocabulary, tone and sentence style the AI should follow in dialogue.
fields.exampleDialogue: Write a few sample lines in their voice to show the AI the style you want.
fields.relationship: Describe how this character feels about the selected person and how they act around them.
fields.knowledgeNotes: Describe what this character knows, doesn't know and keeps secret when the story begins.
fields.relationshipTarget: Choose who these notes are about.

constraints: Persistent help below card text fields, not placeholder-only; optional inclusion note once per editor; no claim of automatic provider sends or runtime knowledge tracking.
